mode.subtitle: Choose how to play
mode.disclaimer: Hodowca is a non-commercial fan project inspired by the classic animal-breeding and trading dice-game mechanic. It is not affiliated with any publisher or rights holder of the original game and is not intended to infringe on anyone's trademarks or intellectual property. It's an experimental "vibe coding" project built with Claude Code (Anthropic).

hotseat.title: Hot seat
hotseat.desc: Play on one screen, passing the device between turns.

online.title: Online / LAN game
online.desc: Each player on their own device, on the same network.
online.warning: Requires internet while players are connecting.

rules.title: 📖 Rules and exchange rates
rules.predatorsText: 🦊 The fox eats rabbits and sheep. 🐺 The wolf hunts pigs, cows and horses. A small dog 🐕 chases off the fox, a big dog 🐕‍🦺 chases off the wolf — but the dog returns to the shared pool after defending, so you'll need to earn a new one.
rules.winText: You win once you hold at least 1 of every animal (rabbit, sheep, pig, cow, horse) and both dogs at the same time.

appHelp.title: ❔ How the app works
appHelp.intro: This isn't the game's rules (those are under "Rules and exchange rates") - these are practical notes on using the app itself.

reload.title: Reloading the page or closing the tab
reload.text: Game state only lives in your browser's memory. Reloading the page, closing the tab, or losing your connection means losing this game's progress - there's no way back, you'll need to start a new one.

hostLeaves.title: The host disconnecting in an online/LAN game
hostLeaves.text: If the host loses connection, the remaining players automatically elect a new host among themselves and the game continues without interruption. If you were the host and come back, you'll rejoin as a new participant - your previous progress in that game is gone.

internetNeeded.title: Online/LAN mode needs internet access
internetNeeded.text: Even if every player is on the same Wi-Fi network, connecting devices to each other requires internet access - it's only used for the initial handshake between devices, the game itself doesn't need to transfer much data afterward.

leaveGame.title: How to leave a game
leaveGame.text: Use the 🚪 button on the board (or the link under the pass-the-device screen) to safely return to mode selection. This also ends the current match with no way to come back to it.
